title: Count Asterisks
summary: Given a string s , where every two consecutive vertical bars | form a pair, count the number of asterisks * in s , excluding those that are between each pair of |.
statement: Given a string s , where every two consecutive vertical bars | form a pair, count the number of asterisks * in s , excluding those that are between each pair of |. Each | will belong to exactly one pair.
constraints: Vertical bars occur in matched pairs.
Characters between each first and second bar of a pair are excluded.
Count asterisks outside all excluded regions.
reference_solution:
def count_asterisks_outside_bars(s):
    return sum(part.count('*') for part in s.split('|')[::2])
hints: Splitting at each bar alternates outside and inside regions.
Outside regions have even indexes in the split result.
Count stars only in slices zero, two, four, and so on.
Matched bars guarantee the parity alternation is exact across the entire string.
editorial: Matched bars guarantee the parity alternation is exact across the entire string.

tests.explanation: The two stars inside each barred region are ignored and two outside stars remain.
There are no asterisks, so the count is zero.
